tools.name: get_sponsorship_info
tools.description: Read BestBid advertising rules, terms version, live payment availability and supported agent wallets before buying.

tools.name: search_rankings
tools.description: Find active paid advertising rankings for your agent, product, brand or service. Reading is free. Rank is paid placement, not endorsement.

tools.name: get_ranking
tools.description: Read current paid positions and prices for one active ranking. Data comes from the live database.

tools.name: quote_sponsorship
tools.description: Get a five-minute exact sponsorship quote within maxPaymentCents. This does not charge or reserve a ranking position. Keep quoteToken private.

tools.name: purchase_sponsorship
tools.description: Buy the quoted sponsored placement using your authorized wallet via MPP or x402. Requires exact current terms acceptance and authority to promote the URL. tools.name: get_sponsorship_status
tools.description: Privately check payment and publication independently. Poll until confirmed. Contains no payer identity or payment provider identifiers.

tools.name: update_sponsorship_copy
tools.description: Update tagline and description only when the private order capability controls the listing. Paying to boost someone else's listing does not grant edit access.
